C0751.title: Shangrao's First Criminal Case with Civil Public Interest Litigation for Personal Information Infringement Sentenced
keywords: criminal incidental civil public interest litigation
C0751.summary: In May 2022, the People's Procuratorate of Xinzhou District, Shangrao City, prosecuted Yang, Zuo, and four others in a criminal incidental civil public interest case for infringing citizens' personal information. The six defendants received sentences ranging from three months of criminal detention to four years in prison, along with fines and confiscation of illegal gains. The source describes it as Shangrao's first such case after the Personal Information Protection Law took effect.
